name: Light of Cambodia
tagline: A light over the rice fields of Pursat
description: Light of Cambodia is a Christ-centered nonprofit partnering with local pastors, teachers, and community leaders in rural Pursat, Cambodia to care for children, strengthen families, and share the hope of the gospel through long-term, relational ministry.

logo.notes: 500x500 RGBA PNG: a cross and flame within a laurel of leaves. PNG is the transparent working mark (used in nav at 100px, verse section at 152px, footer at 72px, and as favicon). JPG is the flat original. Logo is sacred: never redraw, recolor, or feed to a diffusion model as a reference; composite the real file.

colors.name: On-Dark Soft
colors.usage: measured as soft text on dark sections; doubles as the only hairline-weight neutral, warm parchment

colors.name: Marigold
colors.usage: gold buttons (.btn-gold), highlights; pairs with Sunlight #fee5b3 oklch(0.93 0.07 85) for glows and footer name

colorsExtended.name: Sunlight
colorsExtended.usage: warm glow highlights, footer wordmark on Evergreen

display.notes: all headings, footer name; single weight face

body.notes: body, buttons, nav; italic 400 also loaded

khmer.notes: all [lang=km] Khmer script kickers and watermarks; bilingual identity is core to the brand

voice.tone: First-person plural, pastoral and plainspoken. Speaks of presence and long-term commitment, never savior language or urgency tactics. Scripture quoted directly (Matthew 5:14). Khmer script woven in as honor to the local language.
messagingPillars: Relational ministry: long-term relationships over short-term solutions
Local partnership: come alongside, never replace, local leaders
Dignity and compassion: every person made in the image of God

imagery.style: Warm documentary photography of real ministry moments in Pursat: golden-hour light, rice fields, communal meals, prayer, construction by local hands.
subjects: local pastors in prayer and discussion
imagery.treatment: Unstaged, dignified, warm color grade; radius 14px on all photos; hero gets evergreen scrim gradient + golden glow overlay
avoid: photos that center foreign visitors over local people

layout.spacing: generous section padding, alternating light/dark bands
postureRules: Pill buttons (border-radius 999px); Flame for primary Give Now, Marigold gold for secondary, ghost outline for tertiary
Alternating full-width bands: photo + copy, flipped every other band (.band / .band-flip)
Dark Evergreen sections (verse, values, footer) use On-Dark cream text and Sunlight highlights
Every section kicker is bilingual: Khmer script first, English label second
Circular logo treatments (border-radius 50%) at nav, verse, and footer
